segments.text: Alright, so this is the interrupt flow page, for LangGraph TypeScript, and I have implemented this page.
So the page has a small demo at the top, and then umm, the implementation steps below it.
It covers setting up the agent state, calling interrupt in the agent, and then handling it in the frontend.
This is the agent from the doc. It uses runnable config without importing it, and uh, it never builds or exports a graph. So I added those to get it running.
Now the demo. I started a chat, and the agent stopped and asked me, before we start, what would you like to call me.
So the interrupt form came up in the chat, umm, with a text box to type the name.
I entered a name, submitted it, and then it answered using that name. So once it's patched, the flow works fine.
But in the doc, the frontend uses the agent id starter agent, while the quickstart registers sample agent.
And the page's own warning says, if the agent id doesn't match, uh, the interrupt will never fire. So following the doc, it just doesn't fire.
So summing it up. Missing import, and no graph in the agent file.
And the agent id doesn't match the quickstart, so ahh, the interrupt never fires.
That's it for this page, so kindly look into it.
